assumptions.scope: Signature, hash, and commitment security for selected algorithms.
assumptions.evidence_method: security review and pinned test vectors
assumptions.freshness_rule: Recheck cryptographic evidence at the applicable signing or execution boundary and after any identity, parameter, or state change.
assumptions.revocation_rule: Revocation, contradiction, substitution, or stale cryptographic evidence invalidates cached acceptance and yields the declared failure result.
